resources.string: Choose how to control your devices. LAN and ZeroTier remain available independently of the VPS.
Owner access using your existing panel login. Devices connect directly to the VPS; this phone is an HTTPS client. Your password stays in memory until logout or closing this screen.
Enter an HTTPS server address and your panel username and password.
Logged out. Enter your panel login to connect.
Connected to the Direct VPS API.

Command failed. Check the current device state.
Confirmation timed out. Check the current device state before retrying.

Panel login rejected. Check your username and password.
Access denied by the panel or outlet policy.
Device offline, control disabled, or another command is pending.
Direct VPS API unavailable. Check that the panel extension is installed.
Could not retrieve the device state. Check your connection and HTTPS server.
